namespace: stored ledger rows + the §9 export documents named on argv; no transcript is opened, no file on disk is stat-ed
probe: C3.0 — capsule section sources, measured before any capsule code

scope_finding.headline: a capsule scoped to one project row can silently under-represent a real project
scope_finding.measured: one project's work fragments across 11 project rows (nine of them `--claude-worktrees-*`), and workspace identity abstains on every one (basis 'unresolvable') because the working roots are gone from disk — so repo scoping cannot reunite them either
scope_finding.rule: the capsule states its own scope as a fact (this project row, N sessions) and, when repo identity does not resolve, SAYS SO. Sibling roots are never guessed from path prefixes — that is the per-repo demangle guess the A156 pin already forbids.

caution_no_proof.note: TWO independent findings: (1) §5s holds 'unsupported' in FULL SHADOW until per-class graduation and the §9 export already excludes it, so surfacing it in a capsule would break the shadow gate; (2) it is a measured zero on beta anyway. The 60 corpus rows sit in one project root. Operator ruling required — see the write-up.

do_not_repeat.note: ATTESTED RUNS ARE A MEASURED ZERO on this machine — every capture table is empty, so the proof-grade half of this section has no rows at all. Only the observed half exists, and a command matching a shape is a CANDIDATE: every entry must carry replay_class 'unknown' citing the C5 operation/replay ledger by name. No safety class may be invented here.
do_not_repeat.source: attested runs (capture_* / source_assurance_attestations) + side-effect-shaped Bash tool_use events

freshness.note: a capsule cites the snapshot it was built beside by digest; applicability is derived at read, never stored twice (A87)
freshness.source: project_heads chain position + the cited workspace snapshot's taken_at/doc_sha256 + ProofApplicability derived at read

in_flight.note: candidate vocabulary only: 'N edits after the last commit — unresolved', never 'dead end'

next_safe_action.note: an inference, never a receipt: labeled Inferred and carrying a basis string in the session_status.rs house style ('the last claim the record backs, and the first it does not')
next_safe_action.source: derived: last supported claim + first unresolved (pending) claim, in recorded order

objective.note: one verbatim ask per session; a session with none renders an honest empty, never an invented objective
objective.source: RB7 Layer-2 OpeningAsk (candidates.opening_asks), rendered under exactly the label 'opening ask' — 'purpose' is a Layer-3 word and stays banned

rejected_paths.note: the packet already prints this honestly: 'no failed-approach object exists; abandoned is set with supersession and explicitly does not mean the work failed'. The capsule OMITS this section in v1 with that measured-zero note rather than faking it from `dropped`.
rejected_paths.source: NONE — no failed-approach object exists in the model

uncertainties.note: 'unknown' is NOT a shadow class — it renders today and is the honest home for unreadable outcomes; C2's gaps string is copied verbatim, never paraphrased
uncertainties.source: nodes at 'unknown' (rendered 'insufficient evidence') + the C2 snapshot's own named v1 gaps

verified_with_receipts.note: VERIFIED IS A MEASURED ZERO CORPUS-WIDE (0 rows): every claim this machine can offer is 'supported' at best, so the section may not be titled 'verified' without laundering a verdict — the packet's RULING 4 already caps nodes at supported and the capsule inherits it
verified_with_receipts.source: nodes at evidence supported/verified, with their anchor receipts
